summary.tldr: Clarifies when border and preclearance officers can examine documents on personal digital devices, and updates related rules, offences and French wording.
what_it_does: Clarifies when border services officers may examine documents stored on personal digital devices under the Customs Act.
Allows regulations to be made about those device examinations.
Updates enforcement, offences and punishment rules in the Customs Act.

Clarifies when preclearance officers may examine, search and detain documents stored on personal digital devices under the Preclearance Act, 2016, and allows regulations and ministerial directions for those actions.
Updates the French version of the Preclearance Act, 2016 about a traveller’s duty to identify themselves.
summary.background: It amends the Customs Act and the Preclearance Act, 2016.
